name: Rocknot's Ale
label: Quest
description: Rocknot's Ale: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, ale! I would kill for some Dark Iron ale!! Quick, I'm getting sober! I know this because sobriety blurs my vision... And it's making you look like the traveler I slew last week!

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Ah! It smells like Dark Iron Ale! Drink has blurred my sight, but I can tell that you, friend, are a real friend!
